name: RC-B10-0520/2026 - Considérant F - Am 12
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: F.whereas the EU is well placed to play a stronger and more coordinated role in shaping upcoming UN initiatives on AI governance; whereas new proposals and existing UN structures on AI within the EU demonstrate growing momentum for dedicated institutional and scientific capacity on global AI governance; whereas the candidacy of Milan, Italy, to host a future UN pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI reflects the EU’s scientific, institutional and multilateral capacity, and should be considered a priority of a coordinated EU approach;
